name: Exploit review R56A-1: a steel dragon in Brimhaven Dungeon breathing dragonfire from out of its reach at a player in a corridor too narrow for it

steps.comment: the bow and arrows go with the scenario: ::reset at the end takes them off again, so later scripts that attack without one don't fire a bow with no arrows (nightly 2026-11-27, combat.no_ammo in callisto, calvarion, chaos-elemental, brimhaven-fighters)

steps.expectMessage: You can't be hurt now (::god again to turn it off).

steps.comment: the metal dragons' cavern, south of the three-wide corridor at 2708-2710, 9471-9472 (read off the real map's collision)
a shot or two, so the dragon comes after the player

halfway first: the corridor tile is 9 north of the teleport tile, too far for the client to draw from here at the default camera (nightly rerun 2026-11-27: not on screen); open, as the dragon gets within 2 of 9472, so its 4x4 body covers this tile
into the corridor: a 4x4 dragon can't get past its 4-wide mouth at 9470, so the player is 2 tiles from it at best
a breath from range (8 tiles, GUESSED); before the fix it couldn't reach the player at all
still in the corridor, out of its melee reach
